messages:
katie: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick thread to collect follow-ups on the Sales pipeline / GTM / Partnerships section. I'll consolidate and tag owners.

emily: big thanks to the GTM team for the numbers — can we get the slide deck link?

katie: yup, deck here: https://redwood.app/slides/q1-gtm (will post the annotated version after this thread) :white_check_mark:

ajay: quick Q — the cadence for partner co-sell motion: is that weekly SDR handoff or monthly pipeline sync?

emily: short answer: weekly for early-stage deals, monthly for enterprise partner account reviews. We're pilot-ing a biweekly cadence for strategic partners.

marc: for forecasting: are partner-sourced deals included in the ARR commit number or tracked separately in the dashboard?

sophie: they're in ARR commit but marked with a partner tag. Marc, we'll add a filter in the dashboard by EOD for transparency.

katie: action: @marc and @sophie to add the partner-filter + create a one-pager on what qualifies as "partner-sourced" for next week.

dan: regarding Dedicated contract timelines — are we prioritizing renewal outreach for the top 10 customers this quarter? need to align AE resources.

emily: yes, priority renewals list will be sent to sales ops today. AEs should expect outreach templates and customer-specific notes midweek.

ajay: a quick ask from partnerships — can marketing amplify a joint-case study template so partners can use it? makes co-sell easier.

katie: good call. @marketing (cc @sophie) — we'll put a template in the partner portal and share an email template for AEs.

marc: pricing question: any update on the per-token discount tiers for Dedicated capacity commitments? heard a rumor about changes.

emily: rumor clarification: no changes this quarter. We're evaluating tiered discounts for next fiscal year; nothing to change in current quotes.

ops-bot: Recording available: All-Hands - 2026-03-23 (link: https://redwood.app/records/ah-2026-03-23)

sophie: can someone set up a 30-min office hours for partner rollout questions? I can host Wed 11am PT.

katie: wed 11am PT works — I'll create the calendar invite and share the meeting notes template.

dan: one more — any guidance on when to use the "dedicated vs hosted" pitch in deal decks? AEs want a short decision tree.

emily: decision tree incoming: short version: sensitive/regulatory or >$X/month -> Dedicated; otherwise Hosted first with Dedicated as escalation. We'll publish the one-slide cheat sheet.

katie: thanks all — I'll collate actions: 1) deck annotated + link 2) partner filter in dashboard (Marc/Sophie) 3) partner case study + email template (Marketing/Sophie) 4) renewals list + templates (Emily/Sales Ops) 5) office hours Wed 11am PT (Sophie/Katie) 6) dedicated vs hosted cheat sheet (Emily/Product). Ping me if I missed anything.

emily: thanks — looks good. :thumbsup:

sophie: noted, will run the partner filter and case study template today.

katie: we'll follow up in this thread with docs and owners attached. Thanks everyone!
